relations.text: 筆頭株主。株式21.33%・議決権32.32%を保有
relations.text_en: Largest shareholder: 21.33% of shares, 32.32% of votes

source.label: Ferrari 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: ("Exor") is our largest shareholder, holding approximately 21.33 percent of our outstanding common shares and approximately 32.32 percent of our voting power (as of February 4, 2026).

relations.text: 旧親会社。傘下マセラティへのエンジン供給は2024年で終了
relations.text_en: Former parent; engine supply to its Maserati ended in 2024

source.label: Ferrari 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Other net revenues were €279 million for 2024 and for 2023, with higher revenues from financial services activities substantially offset by the end of the supply of engines to Maserati.

companies.name: クレディ・アグリコル

relations.text: 欧州の販売金融を傘下CAオートバンクとの提携会社で提供
relations.text_en: European dealer and retail financing through a CA Auto Bank partnership

source.label: Ferrari 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Our dealer and retail customer financing in Europe are mainly provided through FFS GmbH, our partnership with CA Auto Bank, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crédit Agricole Consumer Finance S.A.

relations.text: 高級スポーツカー市場の競合

source.label: Ferrari 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: • We identify the Luxury Performance Car Industry to include all two-door luxury sports cars with power above 500 hp, and retail price above Euro 200,000 (Italian market price including VAT as reference) sold by Aston Martin, Audi, Bentley, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, McLaren, Mercedes Benz, Porsche and Rolls-Royce.
